# Whallm 1.1.14-dev.1
Development prerelease. Changes since v1.1.13. Select **Settings → Updates → Dev** to receive dev updates; the stable channel remains on v1.1.13.
## DeepSeek V4.1 Native engine
- DeepSeek V4.1 now uses the bundled C++ and Metal Native engine instead of MLX, including text generation, DSpark and Memory/Disk Prompt Cache. - Existing model files, API model ID, installation and Alias stay unchanged. DSpark experts share the main expert cache. - Automatic expert cache sizing uses available memory at model load, from 256 to 4,096 slots. Fixed caches must hold at least 96 experts. - Advanced Settings no longer offers MLX-only controls for this model. Approximate mode and incompatible MLX-specific runtime options are rejected. - Developer messages are encoded as system messages for DeepSeek V4.1, including tool conversations.
## App and logging
- Fix the main window layout so navigation and Logs remain visible, including at smaller window sizes. - Add runtime event logging and an optional **Save logs to file** setting. File logging is off by default and keeps at most 10 MB in `~/.whallm/server.log`, removing oldest lines first. - Debug events omit full prompts, tool results, images and API keys. Logs can still contain local paths and network addresses; review them before sharing.
## API output limits
- Tool-enabled requests that exhaust their output budget preserve the length-limit result rather than failing solely because thinking or tool markup is unfinished. - Chat keeps `finish_reason: "length"` and token usage. Responses reports `status: "incomplete"`, `incomplete_details.reason: "max_output_tokens"`, and `response.incomplete` for streaming requests. - Required-tool requests do not spend a second output budget after reaching the limit. Malformed completed output remains an error.
## Upgrade and validation limits
- Quit the old App and restart with this build. No model redownload is required. DeepSeek V4.1 prompt caches from MLX are not reused; native caches rebuild on demand. Saved MLX-only tuning no longer applies. - This is a dev build, not a new stable release. MiMo remains a preview, and the server still handles one generation request at a time. - API regression tests use fixed model output; they do not establish real-model tool quality or full Pi/Codex compatibility. - Earlier DeepSeek V4.1 checks on M2 Max observed greedy output matching MLX. These are limited observations, not broad quality validation. Inputs longer than 16,000 tokens and M5 performance remain unvalidated; DSpark speed has not been remeasured after the latest changes. - No new real-model performance or quality measurements are claimed for this release. See [the usage reference](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/blob/v1.1.14-dev.1/docs/usage.md) and [benchmark limitations](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/blob/v1.1.14-dev.1/BENCHMARK.md).

# Whallm 1.1.13
Changes since v1.1.12.
## Native engine for both Qwen models
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Swift1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next now run on the bundled C++ and Metal engine instead of MLX. - Existing model downloads, display names, API model IDs and Aliases stay unchanged. Both models support text, still images, MTP and Prompt Cache. - **Size the expert cache automatically** uses the memory available when a model loads, up to 8,192 slots. Turn it off to choose a fixed cache size. - New or reset settings enable automatic expert cache sizing, MTP and **Use 8-bit resident weights**. Saved generation, read-worker, MTP and 8-bit choices are retained. - Advanced Settings no longer shows MLX-only controls or a separate MTP expert cache size for these models.
## Model settings and API
- **Context window** sets the maximum combined input and output length for each request, within the model's supported limit. Requests that exceed it return `context_length_exceeded`. - `GET /v1/models` includes each model's context window and capabilities in its `data` entries. - The model list shows newer models first and no longer clips the available rows into a short inner list. - Throughput durations use units appropriate to their length.
## Upgrade notes
- Quit the old App before opening this version. Model weights do not need to be downloaded again. - MLX Prompt Cache files are not reused by the Native engine; prompts are processed again as needed. Native output can differ from MLX output. - The two temporary `-native` preview model IDs have been removed. If you used them, switch to `qwen3.8-flash-next-fp8` or `swift1.5-qwen3.8-flash-next-mxfp4`. - Custom Qwen runtime configurations must leave MLX-only options at their defaults; other values are rejected. The App handles this automatically. - Clients reading the former top-level `models` or `object` fields from `GET /v1/models` must use the `data` array instead.
## Validation and limits
- 767 Python tests ran with one skipped and no failures; 199 Swift tests ran with four skipped and no failures. All 24 release-script tests passed. - Local App and ZIP checks passed for signatures, bundled model files, and startup in English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese without access to the build folder or Swift localization bundle. - Prior Native checks on M2 Max covered short text, Chat, Responses, streaming and images for both models. Broad quality, performance and M5 validation remain incomplete. Earlier MLX benchmarks do not describe this engine.
Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15 or later. Model weights are downloaded separately. Distribution builds exclude local-only debug and Dry run features.
[Full changelog](https://github.com/yanun0323/Whallm/compare/v1.1.12...v1.1.13)
